text:
`ReducedInterest` materializes a downstream `LogicalInterest` by filling dynamic slots in an `InterestShape` template:

- `authors`
- `event_ids`
- `addresses`
- `tags[key]`
 [...] - `InterestShape` has `event_ids`, generic `tags`, and internal `addresses`: `crates/nmp-planner/src/interest.rs:127`.
- JSON `open_interest` maps `ids` and `#x` tags, but not `#a` into typed `addresses`: `crates/nmp-planner/src/interest.rs:252`.
